test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

All cars are bus.

All buses are truck.

Conclusions:

(I) Some trucks are cars.

(II) All cars are trucks.
solution:
Given Statements:

All cars are bus.

All buses are truck.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0de7374af70bd9be363cd7ce54e8f5bf1278e237d3582e2c32eae65d4d14f268.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e248f5216be8cac1fc8d8e9c9065b3ee66b116b328e49961c0dc95b1e4bc64bc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some trucks are cars - **True** (Since all cars are buses, and all buses are trucks, it means all cars are also trucks. Therefore, some trucks must definitely be cars.)

II. All cars are trucks - **True** (If all cars fall within the category of buses, and all buses fall within the category of trucks, then it logically follows that all cars are also trucks.)

So, both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
